title: Covariant/contravariant bases + metric tensors (curvilinear reference)
objective: Extend `mechdsl.symbolic.convected` to support curvilinear reference configurations with non-trivial G_{IJ}. Implement g_I = F G_I, g_IJ, g^IJ (inverse metric), and contravariant bases g^I = g^{IJ} g_J.

plan_assets.asset_description: B2.1 convected bases definition: g_I = dx/dtheta^I = F G_I with full metric tensor machinery.

scope: Extend the existing (Cartesian-reference) `mechdsl.symbolic.convected` module to accept a user-supplied `G_IJ(theta)` metric tensor expression.
Compute `g_IJ = F^T G F` (convected pushforward) for a given deformation gradient.
Invert g_IJ symbolically or numerically to get g^{IJ}.
Produce covariant and contravariant base vectors at an arbitrary material point.
Preserve the MVP Cartesian-reference fast path: when G_{IJ} = delta_{IJ}, the new code must match the existing one byte-for-byte.
implementation_steps: Audit the existing `mechdsl.symbolic.convected` module to identify the Cartesian assumptions (G = I).
Add a `MetricField` abstraction that can be either Cartesian (fast path) or a user-supplied SymPy expression.
Add symbolic helpers for g_IJ pushforward and g^{IJ} inversion.
Add unit tests verifying Cartesian-reference unchanged and a cylindrical-coordinate example with a known G_IJ.
acceptance_criteria: Cartesian reference (`G = I3`) path produces identical output to the current MVP.
Cylindrical coordinates example computes g_IJ analytically and numerically and they agree.
Metric inversion returns `g^{IJ}` such that g^{IK} g_{KJ} = delta^I_J to 1e-12.
risks: Symbolic metric inversion is expensive for generic G. Mitigation: allow numerical inversion as a fallback when `simplify(det(G)) != 0` is not tractable.
completion_notes: Gate A: failed attempt 1 (test_gap — covariant_bases curvilinear branch untested), passed attempt 2 after adding test_covariant_bases_curvilinear

Gate B: failed attempt 1 (physics_error — F^T G F formula wrong for Cartesian F with curvilinear G), passed attempt 2 after correcting to G_ref_vecs^T C G_ref_vecs, adding symmetry validation, and cross-consistency test
Gate C: 1038/1039 passed (1 pre-existing failure unrelated)
